verdict.rationale: Trello offers shared, visual card-based boards that teams can collaborate on, and it is pitched to design teams for creative requests and cross-team work. Hands-on users also praise the easy 'add people' feature. However, nothing in the evidence describes a freeform whiteboard or canvas for drawing, sketching or spatial layout; the visual collaboration is limited to structured kanban lists and cards. Missing for 10: a freeform whiteboard canvas, drawing/sketching or sticky-note tools, real-time co-editing of a visual canvas, and independent corroboration of whiteboard-style use by designers.
